meta.name: article-illustrator
meta.description: 内容创作者和自媒体创作者在撰写长文时，当需要“给文章配图”或“添加插图”时使用。自动分析文章结构，精准识别需要视觉辅助的位置，生成并插入契合语境的插画，将抽象概念具象化，一键完成高质量图文排版，大幅提升阅读体验。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为长文自动生成贴切插画，提升阅读体验
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果写长文时总为配图发愁
copy.tagline_en: Automatically generate fitting illustrations for articles to enhance reading.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often struggle to find images for your articles.

howto.what: 它会读入你的文章(本地 Markdown 文件或 URL)，逐段找出适合配图的位置，生成配图计划和插画，把图片插到对应段落后、保存到 imgs/ 目录，最后给出完成汇总。
howto.when: 当你明确要求「给文章配图」「添加配图」等，或要为长文生成插图时，它会接管这件事。

say.text: 帮我给这篇文章配图，文件在 ./post.md
say.note: 它会分析全文并逐段插入插画。

say.text: 为这篇文章生成 5 张插图，用科幻未来感风格
say.note: 按你给的数量与风格生成。

say.text: 给 https://example.com/post 这篇文章添加配图
say.note: 自动下载 Markdown 内容后再配图。

howto.what_en: It reads your article (a local Markdown file or a URL), finds the passages that need visuals, writes an illustration plan and generates the images, inserts them after the matching paragraphs into an imgs/ folder, then reports a summary.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you explicitly ask to illustrate an article, e.g. "add illustrations to this article" or "generate images for this article".

say_en.text: Illustrate this article for me, the file is ./post.md
say_en.note: It analyzes the full text and inserts images section by section.

say_en.text: Generate 5 illustrations for this article in a sci-fi style
say_en.note: Uses the count and style you give.

say_en.text: Add illustrations to the article at https://example.com/post
say_en.note: Downloads the Markdown, then illustrates it.
